method: Each quotation in the three Foundations essays was paired with the citation that follows it and searched for in a text of the cited source fetched on Nov. 21-22, 2026 (normalized for case, punctuation and line breaks; bracketed alterations and ellipses split the quotation into fragments). found = every fragment present; found-fuzzy = at least 75% of four-word runs present (page breaks or OCR); partial or not-found = not confirmed by machine; no-text = no usable text fetched (site blocked scripts, image-only PDF, or JavaScript page); too-short = under three words; hand-checked = confirmed by reading the source named; citator-label = a quoted KeyCite flag label, not opinion text.
